turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Reese Dunlap, thanks for having me out today to look at your water heater.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for coming, come on in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Have you looked at other options before reaching out to us?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly our old unit finally gave out last week.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: For the package we discussed, the total cost is $4,200.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll need to talk to my spouse before we commit to anything.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Okay, well, the price is the price, but let me know if you change your mind.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Alright, well, feel free to reach out whenever you're ready.
